Subject: RE: Unexpected token charges during free trial + VAT on invoice

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for the details. I'm Marcus from Billing & Partnerships — I pulled the backend usage and invoice for GB-4021. Summary of findings: 
- Trial credits were applied at signup, but the account consumed ~12k tokens beyond the 10k free trial allowance on 2026-06-14 due to a single high-throughput API key that appears to have been used by a staging pipeline.
- Those extra tokens generated an invoice line for $18.40. VAT (20%) was applied on that line because our billing system treats paid usage as taxable in your region; trial credits themselves are non-taxable.

Next steps I can take immediately: 
1) Issue a one-time credit for the billed amount ($18.40) to reverse the charge — will reflect as a credit memo on your account and a negative line on the next invoice.
2) Remove the VAT line associated with that reversed charge once we have your VAT ID on record (GB123456789) and validate it.
3) Approve a 30-day trial extension (manual override) so you have another window to test with the free credits.

If that plan works for you I will queue the credit and the trial extension; Monica, can you confirm the credit memo id and timeline for VAT reversal once Marcus issues the credit?

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Billing Operations Lead
Redwood Inference
